scope: Fresh zero-authorship source re-review of the guest Scrape T07/T09 driver and focused tests. No native, heavy test, build, release, or credential run; no product pass claimed.

prior_finding.resolved_parts: Every one of the 21 copy actions in each run seeds a distinct per-fixture/menu/option sentinel immediately before the trusted menu click. The same seven menus run on intake, referrals after navigation, and intake after extension reload. The driver checks selected option structure, fixture-specific content, stale-page text, and permission restoration. T07 now records source-page scrollY at start, on, and off, alongside panel scroller position and toggle state.
prior_finding.remaining_blocker: The representation oracle rejects a correct Copy schema / For AI agent result: copyOracle requires a ```markdown fence for every AI option, while schemaCopyOptions calls wrapJsonForAgent, which emits ```json. A source-realistic JSON-fenced value with pretty-printed metadata/title and Dentist schema returned false; replacing only the fence with markdown returned true. This would make a healthy native T09 run fail.
prior_finding.negative_path_limit: The three focused unit tests invoke copyOracle, copyResultMatches, menuMatches, and scrollSyncMatches directly. They do not invoke runGuestCopyMenus or the trusted click/clipboard read path, so no-op and wrong-format mutations are not demonstrated through the real verification path. The native run remains the needed integration proof after the oracle is corrected.

verdict_A_native_readiness.T07: Source-ready: warm and full-reload runs use native page wheel input, observe page scrollY movement, panel Article scroller movement while on, and panel hold while off. Native outcome pending.
verdict_A_native_readiness.T09: Blocked by the schema AI oracle false negative. All seven menu rosters and 21 selected options are traversed on both owned pages, with intake repeated after full extension reload; a passing native result cannot be produced for a correct schema AI copy until the oracle accepts its JSON fence.
verdict_A_native_readiness.artifact: The prior peer established frozen 0.2.391 as a technically selectable bounded target for the newer driver, with its own source identity verified by the importer; exact current-source provenance needs a newer artifact. Neither target has a new native outcome in this review.

verdict_B_quality.finding: Independent fixture-specific assertions improve the oracle, but its universal Markdown-fence check conflicts with the real JSON wrapper in the schema path. Focused tests omit that valid branch and test only helper predicates, leaving the real copy path without a demonstrated forcing negative.
verdict_B_quality.preserved: The copy option still uses the shared driver's visible, hit-tested CDP pointer action. Clipboard read permission is temporary and restored. T07 source-page movement and panel off-state proof are retained.

evidence: A read-only node oracle probe returned JSON-fenced correct schema AI=false and identical Markdown-fenced value=true.
